protocol_metadata.about: Zircuit Staking (ZtakingPool) is an Ethereum-mainnet multi-token staking pool that allows users to deposit liquid restaking tokens (LRTs), liquid staking tokens (LSTs), and other accepted assets to earn Zircuit points and partner airdrops. Users deposit tokens via depositFor() or ETH via depositETHFor(), and may withdraw at any time; off-chain processes read on-chain Deposit/Withdraw events to compute point balances. The protocol also supports a migrate() pathway — gated by a Zircuit-controlled signer signature — that moves user liquidity to the Zircuit Layer 2 via an approved migrator contract.
